Good evening, ladies and gentlemen! Team owners, coaches, analysts, and all our franchise families... a very warm welcome to the Auction Premier League!
Before the hammer comes down, let's welcome our ten franchises!
What a line-up! One more big round of applause for all ten franchises!
Before we begin, a quick look at today's rules.
Every franchise has a fixed purse of one hundred and twenty crore rupees. Once it's spent, it's gone.
Each squad needs at least eighteen players, and can have up to twenty five, with no more than eight overseas players.

Each squad needs at least eighteen players, and can have up to twenty five, with no more than eight overseas players.
Finish short of the minimum, and the empty slots are filled with base price players.
Retained players have already been paid for, from your purse.
Each franchise has one Right to Match card, to take back a player from last season, at the final bid.
When the bidding stops, it's going once... going twice... and sold!
Good luck to all ten franchises. Let the auction begin!
